# Gender

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Gender`](gmeow-Gender.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Gender>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/gender`](../../slices/gender.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A gender a person may identify with — a VALUE, never a [`gmeow:Person`](gmeow-Person.md) subclass. The set is open and culturally diverse; a gender not among the seed individuals is a FRESH [`gmeow:Gender`](gmeow-Gender.md) individual carrying [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label), not a new class. Pointed at by [`gmeow:genderValue`](../properties/gmeow-genderValue.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Gender`](gmeow-Gender.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the open value vocabulary for the gender a [`gmeow:genderValue`](../properties/gmeow-genderValue.md) points at; mint a fresh individual with [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) when no seeded value fits the culture or identity.

### Avoid when

- Avoid modelling a gender as a [`gmeow:Person`](gmeow-Person.md) subclass or a forced enum, and avoid treating the binary seeds as a default — every value is co-equal ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)), so none is primary.

### How to use

- Reference a seeded [`gmeow:Gender`](gmeow-Gender.md) individual or add a fresh one carrying [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) and the GSSO/Homosaurus alignments; expose it only through a [`gmeow:GenderIdentity`](gmeow-GenderIdentity.md) facet, never a flat literal.

### Examples

- ex:genderXochihua a [`gmeow:Gender`](gmeow-Gender.md); [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) "xochihua"@en.
